hero.title: Let your phone play Tap Titans 2 while you do something else
hero.text: The bot taps, casts skills, levels heroes and prestiges on your own Android phone, driven from your computer over USB.

features.title: Auto tap
features.text: Fast, steady taps on the titan, paced so the game keeps up.

features.title: Skills
features.text: Casts your skills the moment they are ready; with Pro it also buys new ones.

features.title: Heroes
features.text: Levels your heroes while you are away.

features.title: Prestige
features.text: Prestiges on a timer; with Pro also at a stage you choose or when progress stalls.

features.title: Panels
features.text: Collects achievements for free; with Pro also eggs, equipment, talents and event rewards.

features.title: Raids
features.text: With Pro, spends your Solo Raid attacks and world portals for you.

features.title: Free trial
features.text: Every Pro feature free for 24 hours, started from the app.

plans.name: Free trial
plans.blurb: Every Pro feature for a day, once per computer.

plans.name: Lifetime
plans.blurb: Pro for as long as the bot exists.

faq.a: Yes. The basic bot is free. The Pro features need the free trial or a Pro pass.
Android phones with USB debugging turned on. The bot is tested on a Samsung Galaxy S8+.

faq.q: Can I use one key on two computers?
faq.a: A Pro key works on one computer at a time. You can move it to another computer up to three times in 30 days.
No. It is built never to tap anything that costs real money.
